description: Purchased trading merchandise on credit from vendor Bengal Electricals ₹60,000 as per Invoice #BE-701
narration: Being trading goods purchased on credit as per Invoice #BE-701
explanation: Initial credit purchase debiting Purchases Expense A/c ₹60,000 and crediting Creditor Liability ₹60,000.

description: Returned defective trading goods worth ₹12,000 to vendor Bengal Electricals and issued Debit Note #DN-101
narration: Being defective goods returned to vendor against Debit Note #DN-101
explanation: Return Outward reduces vendor trade liability: Debit Sundry Creditor ₹12,000, Credit Return Outward Account (Return Outward) ₹12,000.

description: Returned wrong specification goods purchased for cash ₹4,500 to vendor Apex Supplies and received instant cash refund ₹4,500
narration: Being instant cash refund received against return of goods purchased for cash
explanation: Cash Return Outward: Increases Cash Asset (Debit Cash A/c ₹4,500), Credit Return Outward Account ₹4,500.

description: Sold trading merchandise on credit to customer Sharma Traders ₹80,000 as per Sales Bill #SB-302
narration: Being goods sold on credit as per Sales Bill #SB-302
explanation: Initial credit sale creating Sundry Debtor Asset (Debit Sharma Traders ₹80,000) and crediting Sales Revenue A/c ₹80,000.

description: Received customer Debit Note return for damaged goods worth ₹15,000 from Sharma Traders and issued Credit Note #CN-201
narration: Being damaged goods returned by customer against Credit Note #CN-201
explanation: Return Inward reduces customer asset: Debit Return Inward Account (Return Inward) ₹15,000, Credit Sundry Debtor ₹15,000.

description: Customer returned retail merchandise ₹2,800 purchased for cash due to minor defect, issued instant cash refund ₹2,800
narration: Being cash refund paid to retail customer upon return of defective merchandise
explanation: Cash Return Inward: Debit Return Inward Account ₹2,800 (reducing net sales), Credit Cash Asset A/c ₹2,800.

description: Returned damaged electrical wire supplies worth ₹8,000 to vendor Metro Cables under Debit Note #DN-102
narration: Being damaged goods returned to vendor under Debit Note #DN-102
explanation: Return Outward: Debit Creditor Liability A/c ₹8,000, Credit Return Outward A/c ₹8,000.

description: Received customer goods return for wrong item model worth ₹9,500 from Sen Bros and issued Credit Note #CN-202
narration: Being wrong item returned by customer against Credit Note #CN-202
explanation: Return Inward: Debit Return Inward A/c ₹9,500, Credit Sundry Debtor A/c ₹9,500.

description: Returned sub-standard raw material stock worth ₹14,000 to vendor Alpha Trading Co under Debit Note #DN-103
narration: Being raw material returned to vendor under Debit Note #DN-103
explanation: Return Outward: Debit Vendor Creditor A/c ₹14,000, Credit Return Outward A/c ₹14,000.

description: Received customer rejected goods return worth ₹6,200 from Gupta Traders and issued Credit Note #CN-203
narration: Being rejected goods returned by customer against Credit Note #CN-203
